top_signals.title: Lagarde Quits ECB Early, French Debt: Global Return
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Alice Gledhill joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss the French bond market, and the decision by ECB president Christine Lagarde to resign on February 7, before the end of her term next October. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: FTC to probe major companies over personalized pricing and pay
top_signals.summary: The Federal Trade Commission ordered nine food delivery, airline and ride-sharing companies to turn over detailed information on how they harness personal data to set individual consumer prices and employee compensation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: 3 Ways AI Agents Already Operate in Your Browser
top_signals.summary: AI agents can control authenticated browsers, interact with corporate applications, and access sensitive data while appearing to act as legitimate employees. Keep Aware examines three ways agents operate inside browsers and why traditional security tools may struggle to distinguish their activity from human users. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Safe Haven Demand Will Persist: Larosiliere
top_signals.summary:
Kay Herr, CIO of US GFICC at JPMorgan Asset Management, and Stephanie Larosiliere, head of fixed income business strategy at Invesco, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US Treasuries on Thursday rose as a selloff in shares of US technology giants revived investor appetite for bonds as insurance against the possibility of an economic slowdown.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
